Sure. Here are the main options in simple terms:

• Wild Charge: a raw cacao powder blend with guarana, maca, and kola nut. Best if you want a stronger morning or workout-style energy boost.
• Kokos Booster: coconut water powder, beetroot, and guarana. Best if you want something lighter and more refreshing for hydration and natural energy.
• Rohkakao Topping Probierpaket: a small tasting set with three cacao variations. Best if you want to try different flavors first or use it on porridge, smoothies, or as a warm drink.
• Rohriegel Bundles: ready-to-eat snack bars in different flavors. Best if you want something convenient you can take on the go.

If you want the easiest first pick, go with the Probierpaket to sample the range. If you want, I can also tell you which one fits mornings, workouts, or sweet snacking best.
